remarks: Sunny, spacious & pet-friendly, this contemporary townhome is located in convenient & desirable Greenfield! Situated on the brim of Greenwich & close to UCONN + downtown Stamford, living is bright and sunny here - enjoy an abundance of windows and space, including an "office/den" nook off the living room! The kitchen features stunning granite countertops, rich cabinetry and stainless steel appliances. You'll reap the economic benefits of green-built certification construction, natural gas heat, tankless hot water, central air AND NO ADDITIONAL FEES. Private, in-unit washer/dryer, parking for 2-cars are included in rent. Greenfield is a Professionally managed community with 24-hour security. Pets are permitted in Greenfield. 2 dogs  35lbs. , 1 dog  60 lbs., 2 cats or 1 dog and 1 cat are allowed. Aggressive breeds are not permitted. Greenfield is a no smoking community.  Interested applicants please submit Greenfield Application found in supplements and credit check through applyconnect or Rentspree ONLY.
